evals.name: return-book
evals.prompt: A clerk says 'save the return'. Draft a discovery conversation and timeline before implementation.
evals.expected_output: Concrete example, owner and observable result.
assertions: Asks what the clerk enters and sees next.
Distinguishes a return intent from a recorded return fact.
Names an owner or asks which history owns a return.

evals.name: unexplained-field
evals.prompt: A bookings list shows a room and a manager approval badge; only RoomReserved is known. Trace the view.
evals.expected_output: Separate supported fields from missing evidence.
assertions: Maps room identity to a concrete event field or key.
Flags the approval badge as unexplained.
Names an actor or question needed to resolve it without inventing a fact.

evals.name: stakeholder-agreement
evals.prompt: A rejected renewal should leave the old expiry visible. Our trace checker is green. What is actually accepted?
evals.expected_output: Trace refusal and distinguish tooling from agreement.
assertions: Records no new renewal fact after rejection.
Keeps the old expiry on the screen.
Requires stakeholder agreement separately and does not create .play by default.
